rows.saying: Experience is the thing you get right after you need it.
rows.note: More accurately perhaps "Experience is something you don't get until just after you need it."

rows.saying: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
Everyone is entitled to his own opinion, but not to his own facts.
The main thing that flying requires is the ability to throw yourself at the ground and miss
rows.note: According to the Guide, flying is notoriously difficult and deliberately intending to miss the ground does not work.  The secret is finding a way to be suddenly and surprisingly distracted just before you hit the ground.
rows.source: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

rows.saying: It always takes longer than you expect, even when you take into account Hofstadter's law.
rows.note: My favourite 'law'.  I'll write a blog post on some other good ones in due course.
rows.source: Douglas Hofstadter in his book 'Gödel, Escher, Bach: an Eternal Golden Braid' from 1979

caption: a few things I've seen or heard that help me better understand some things in life
